responsibility: Implements shared #pragma handling for C-family front ends. It parses built-in pragmas such as pack, weak, GCC visibility/diagnostic/target/optimize options, scalar_storage_order, and PCH-related directives, maintains pragma registration tables and handler dispatch for both built-in and plugin-provided pragmas, and initializes deferred cpplib pragma recognition for OpenMP and OpenACC namespaces based on enabled language options.
same_name_distinction: Pragma-processing implementation: unlike c-pragma.h, which declares pragma IDs, clause enums, handler types, and registration APIs, this file contains the actual built-in pragma parsers, handler dispatch/registration state, and initialization of deferred pragma recognition.
